outcomeNote: A baraita cited without discussion in this unit.

segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: שׁוֹר תָּם שֶׁהִזִּיק; עַד שֶׁלֹּא עָמַד בַּדִּין – מְכָרוֹ מָכוּר, הִקְדִּישׁוֹ מוּקְדָּשׁ, שְׁחָטוֹ וּנְתָנוֹ בְּמַתָּנָה – מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה עָשׂוּי. מִשֶּׁעָמַד בַּדִּין – מְכָרוֹ אֵינוֹ מָכוּר, הִקְדִּישׁוֹ אֵינוֹ מוּקְדָּשׁ, שְׁחָטוֹ וּנְתָנוֹ בְּמַתָּנָה – לֹא עָשָׂה וְלֹא כְלוּם.
segments.en: § «The Sages taught» in a baraita: With regard to «an innocuous ox that caused damage,» if, «before» its owner «stood trial, he sold it,» it is «sold.» If «he consecrated it,» it is «consecrated.» If «he slaughtered it or gave it as a gift, what he did is done,» i.e., takes effect. By contrast, «once he stood trial» and is now obligated to pay the injured party, if «he sold it, it is not sold;» if «he consecrated it, it is not consecrated;» if «he slaughtered it or gave it is a gift, he has done nothing.»

segments.he: קָדְמוּ בַּעֲלֵי חוֹבוֹת (וְהִגְבִּיהוֹ) [וְגָבוּהוּ]; בֵּין חָב עַד שֶׁלֹּא הִזִּיק, בֵּין הִזִּיק עַד שֶׁלֹּא חָב – לֹא עָשׂוּ וְלֹא כְּלוּם, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין מִשְׁתַּלֵּם אֶלָּא מִגּוּפוֹ.
segments.en: If «creditors» of the ox’s owner «collected» the ox «first, whether he owed» the creditors «before» his ox «caused» the «damage or whether it caused» the «damage before he owed» them, «they have done nothing.» Their collection is void, «because» compensation to the injured party is «paid only from the body of» the ox, as it was innocuous, and it is therefore designated exclusively for this compensation.

segments.he: מוּעָד שֶׁהִזִּיק – בֵּין שֶׁעָמַד בַּדִּין, בֵּין שֶׁלֹּא עָמַד בַּדִּין; מְכָרוֹ מָכוּר, הִקְדִּישׁוֹ מוּקְדָּשׁ, שְׁחָטוֹ וּנְתָנוֹ בְּמַתָּנָה – מָה שֶּׁעָשָׂה עָשׂוּי. קָדְמוּ בַּעֲלֵי חוֹבוֹת (וְהִגְבִּיהוּ) [וְגָבוּהוּ]; בֵּין חָב עַד שֶׁלֹּא הִזִּיק, בֵּין הִזִּיק עַד שֶׁלֹּא חָב – מַה שֶּׁעָשָׂה עָשׂוּי, לְפִי שֶׁאֵין מִשְׁתַּלֵּם אֶלָּא מִן הָעֲלִיָּיה.
segments.en: The baraita continues: With regard to «a forewarned» ox «that caused damage, whether» its owner «stood trial or whether he did not stand trial,» if «he sold it,» it is «sold;» if «he consecrated it,» it is «consecrated;» if «he slaughtered it or gave it as a gift, what he did is done.» Likewise, if «creditors collected» the ox «first, whether he owed» them «before it caused» the «damage,» or «whether it caused» the «damage before he owed» them, «what» they «did is done.» This is «because» the restitution is «paid only from» his «superior-quality» property, not from the body of the ox. Therefore, what he or his creditors do with the ox takes effect.
